FX-AMAP-001.says: straight_256.amp, one straight table: the drawing, unchanged but for rounding.

FX-AMAP-002.says: master_256.amp, one table, the master, a lightening curve (entry x is 255 (x / 255)^0.6): every colour channel through it, black kept, the grey #808080 to #a9a9a9, the blue #3a6fd8 to #699be7.

FX-AMAP-003.says: rgb_768.amp, three tables, red, green and blue, the master left straight: red inverted, green flattened to between 64 and 191, blue along a quarter sine; white to #00bfff, black to #ff4000.

FX-AMAP-004.says: master_rgb_1024.amp, four tables, the master (an S-curve) then red (a power of 1.5), green (inverted) and blue (lifted to 30 and narrowed): each channel through its own table, then the master.

FX-AMAP-005.says: alpha_1280.amp, five tables, FX-AMAP-004's four and an alpha table (the square root), Apply Phase Map To Alpha off: FX-AMAP-004's picture; alpha untouched.

FX-AMAP-006.says: FX-AMAP-005 with Apply Phase Map To Alpha on: the colours as FX-AMAP-005, and the covering through the fifth table, the half-covered column to 181 of 255 and the quarter one to 128, the straight colour kept.

FX-AMAP-007.says: two_512.amp, two tables: the master (inverted) and red (squared); green and blue straight, so every channel is inverted and red squared first.

FX-AMAP-008.says: FX-AMAP-002 with phase 64: the master cycled 64 levels right, so entry x is what entry x - 64 was, wrapping: black (entry 0) takes entry 192's value, and the grey takes entry 64's.

FX-AMAP-009.says: FX-AMAP-003 with phase -100.25: each of the three tables cycled left, between entries mixed; the master, which the file does not hold, stays straight.

FX-AMAP-010.says: FX-AMAP-002 with the phase keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 96 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 FX-AMAP-002, frame 2 cycled 48, frame 4 cycled 96.

FX-AMAP-011.says: FX-AMAP-002 with Apply Phase Map To Alpha on: master_256.amp has no alpha table, so alpha is left as it is: FX-AMAP-002's picture.

FX-AMAP-012.says: FX-AMAP-006 with phase 100: the alpha table cycled with the others, so a pixel that did not show (entry 0 takes entry 156's value, 199) now shows, black, at 199 of 255.

FX-AMAP-013.says: No map file chosen, the effect as it is added: the drawing, untouched, with no warning.

FX-AMAP-014.says: FX-AMAP-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-AMAP-015.says: The map asset's file maps/gone.amp is not there: the drawing, untouched, with MEDIA_MISSING when the file is opened and at every frame; the asset and the setting are kept, to relink.

FX-AMAP-016.says: The setting names asset-nothing, which the project does not have: the drawing, untouched, with EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID; the setting is kept as written.

FX-AMAP-017.says: The setting names asset-bands, the drawing, which is not a lookup file: the drawing, untouched, with EFFECT_PARAMETER_INVALID.

FX-AMAP-018.says: Phase 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AMAP-019.says: Phase -256, below -255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AMAP-020.says: Phase keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AMAP-021.says: Apply Phase Map To Alpha "yes", not "off" or "on". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

unreadable.says: The map asset's file is maps/refused/odd_300.amp, 300 bytes: the drawing, untouched, with MEDIA_DECODE_FAILED at every frame and nothing on opening; the asset and the setting are kept.
